title: Slant
description: Blend from orange (1.0, 0.6, 0.1) at the bottom-left corner to magenta (0.8, 0.1, 0.6) at the top-right corner. The blend runs along the diagonal, so every point on a line from bottom-right to top-left has the same color.
hintText: The blend amount is the average of uv.x and uv.y. Use it as the third argument of mix().
